purpose: Bounded comparison of installed local VLM photo observations; not calibration or model training

sample.review: Existing assistant visual review plus separate assistant inspection of all five photographs

baseline.schema: id, visible, confidence, count, countExact, evidence; Russian evidence <=120 characters

photos.review: Fridge, table and shelves are supported by separate visual inspection. Bench/sofa is ambiguous. Generic roomFurniture remains review-only.

rejectedCompactCandidate.schema: id, confidence, evidence; English evidence <=72 characters; caller supplies visible=true and no counts

singlePhotoDiagnostic.interpretation: The model repeats and invents categories within a truncated invalid response. A shorter wire schema did not repair the behavior. The evidence does not establish a template mismatch or a single causal decoding parameter.

fixedPresenceProtocolProbe.schema: One object with 55 canonical category properties, all required; every value is present, absent or uncertain; additionalProperties=false; no arrays, free text, counts or confidence on the wire
fixedPresenceProtocolProbe.normalization: Positive classifications are review-only proposals with confidence=null, count=null, autoEligible=false and no invented identifying detail. Absent and uncertain do not become property facts.
fixedPresenceProtocolProbe.interpretation: Fixed required properties eliminated the repeated-array failure on these five photographs and retained the core fridge, bed and TV observations. This is a protocol success, not full recognition or precision calibration. Category overlap remains: desk/coffeeTable for the fridge scene, sink/washbasin in the kitchen, and closet without a confirmed walk-in closet. Unlabelled predictions require inspection and are not all declared false positives.

worldAlbumBudgetReview.scope: Whole-album inventory phase of asynchronous import or card preparation
worldAlbumBudgetReview.bounds: Album uses min(caller, configured budget, 1800); each World worker retains cold-start 60s / later 20s caps and the remaining album deadline.
worldAlbumBudgetReview.outerCalls: Import and card preparation return asynchronous job IDs; status polling has per-request timeouts but no shorter whole-job deadline.
worldAlbumBudgetReview.memoryLifecycle: One CPU model worker per photograph, sequential ORT, two intra-op threads. Worker exit releases its model session; timeout/cancel cleanup terminates, kills if required, reaps, and closes temporary input and pipes.
caveats: The configuration is part of the per-photo cache identity, so changing 60 to 600 invalidates prior analysis cache entries once.
Mac import has a cancellation action. The current phone job panel has retry/resume but no job-cancel control; the album deadline still bounds the vision phase.

The separate Mac editor per-photo synchronous API now has a route-specific 125s HTTP deadline instead of 15s. This fixes premature client timeouts; raising the album budget does not alter the per-photo server limits.
The budget is additional processing time, not a promise that all photos or objects will be recognized. Errors and remaining photos retain partial status.

decision.retainedChange: Report actual generated-token metrics on failed/truncated responses while continuing to reject their objects; give only the synchronous Mac photo-analysis API a 125s client deadline. Other request budgets remain unchanged.
decision.fixedPresenceProtocolStatus: Development probe only; no production switch or automatic factual acceptance

limitations: This five-photo development probe is too small to validate per-class automatic acceptance.
Model-reported confidence is not a measured probability of correctness.
The supported feature catalog lacks toilet, towel rail and vanity table; rooms and brands have no inventory fields.
Failed or unprocessed photographs remain unknown; they do not establish object absence.
